label: Bible Study
prompt: And the LORD shall be _____ over all the earth: in that day shall there be one LORD, and his name one.
verse: And the LORD shall be king over all the earth: in that day shall there be one LORD, and his name one.
note: The prophecy's grand finale — one LORD, one name, King over all the earth.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And the disciples were filled with _____, and with the Holy Ghost.
verse: And the disciples were filled with joy, and with the Holy Ghost.
note: Even after being run out of Antioch, the disciples were filled with joy.

label: Sunday School
prompt: The _____ are a people not strong, yet they prepare their meat in the summer;
verse: The ants are a people not strong, yet they prepare their meat in the summer;
note: Small but smart: the ants aren't strong, yet they stock up their food in summer.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Behold, this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom, pride, fulness of bread, and abundance of _____ was in her and in her daughters, neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
verse: Behold, this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom, pride, fulness of bread, and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters, neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
note: Ezekiel's surprising list of Sodom's sins starts with pride, overfed comfort, and ignoring the poor.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And when they found them not, they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city, crying, These that have turned the world _____ down are come hither also;
verse: And when they found them not, they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city, crying, These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also;
note: The Thessalonian mob's complaint became a compliment: these men 'have turned the world upside down.'
